entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I hope you can help. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse monitor. I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number, please?

Yes, it's Alex Chen, order number 884-515-092. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, I really love your products normally. I guess this one just wasn't for me, and honestly, I really needed the money back.
Thank you, Alex. I see your order here. You received it 19 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

It's just a preference thing. But the real problem is, I tried to return it about ten days ago. I went online, but there was a huge **website error**. The whole return **system** seemed to be **down**.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. So you attempted to process the return online but were unable to?

Exactly. I **couldn't print** the label or even get the page to load. I got so worried I wouldn't be able to return it that I even took a **screenshot** of the error message. I was just so stressed about it.

I completely understand your frustration, Alex, and I appreciate you telling me that. Let me check our system logs for that timeframe... Yes, it looks like we had a known system outage that impacted the returns portal around that time. I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience that caused you.
Let me just pull up our return policy to get this sorted for you... Okay, I'm looking at our knowledge base here, and it says all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So I can still return it?
Absolutely. Since you only received it 19 days ago, you are well within that 90-day window. We can definitely get this processed for you right now.
Oh, thank you! That's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much, Diana.

You are most welcome, Alex. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. You should see the refund within 3-5 business days after we receive it.
That's fantastic. You've really helped me out today. Thanks again.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that was it. Have a great day!
You too, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
